raw.title: Frankokratia
raw.description: Period of Greek history following the Fourth Crusade (1204)
raw.extract: The Frankish Occupation, also known as the Latin Occupation and, for the Venetian domains, Venetian Occupation, were the collection of primarily French and Italian states, fiefs and colonies that were established by the Partitio terrarum imperii Romaniae on the territory of the partitioned Byzantine Empire following the Sack of Constantinople of 1204 during the Fourth Crusade.
